<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Vicharamuni (Awakener Naga)](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3104)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Awakener nagas are benevolent and wise teachers of people and places. They seek to guide and nurture the world around them, sensing mortals or locales with potential supernatural significance. Once located, these nagas provide instruction and divine trials to forge their wards toward strength and to impart a deeper understanding of right and wrong. Though considered stern and intimidating taskmasters by their students, those taught by a vicharamuni often go on to become great heroes.

 Awakener nagas are similarly attentive in guiding their young. Upon reaching adulthood, a naga is provided a final trial before being encouraged to depart the nest and seek out their own natural wonders or promising mortals. Sometimes generations of nagas might guard the same place or family line, passing the honor of such care from parent to child. In such cases, the parent nagas aim to have at least one of their children elect to stay behind and become the guardian of their ancestral ward, giving the parents peace of mind that the site they protect will continue to be guarded by their descendants.

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet, swim 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
fangs +22 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 3d10+8 piercing plus vicharamuni venom

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
tail +22 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 3d8+8 bludgeoning plus coils of knowledge

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
spit +22 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [range increment 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)),
**Damage** vicharamuni venom

**Divine Spontaneous Spells** DC 29, attack +21
- **Cantrips (5th)**
[Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Frostbite](/Spells.aspx?ID=1539), [Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246), [Stabilize](/Spells.aspx?ID=307), [Telekinetic Hand](/Spells.aspx?ID=1715)
- **1st**
[Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Protection](/Spells.aspx?ID=238), [Spirit Link](/Spells.aspx?ID=302) (4 slots)
- **2nd**
[Calm](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458), [Noise Blast](/Spells.aspx?ID=1616), [See the Unseen](/Spells.aspx?ID=1663) (4 slots)
- **3rd**
[Crisis of Faith](/Spells.aspx?ID=55), [Holy Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=1557), [Mind Reading](/Spells.aspx?ID=194) (4 slots)
- **4th**
[Cleanse Affliction](/Spells.aspx?ID=1467), [Lightning Bolt](/Spells.aspx?ID=172), [Fly](/Spells.aspx?ID=125) (4 slots)
- **5th**
[Breath of Life](/Spells.aspx?ID=29), [Dispel Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), [Divine Immolation](/Spells.aspx?ID=1496) (4 slots)

**Coils of Knowledge**  ([Force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)) The naga's grip is more spiritual than physical. A creature hit by a smaranava's tail must succeed at a DC 29 Will save or become [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) by the tail until they [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296), the naga releases them with an Interact action, or the naga dies. A captive takes a –4 status penalty to Escape, but can choose to attempt an [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44) or [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46) check to Escape instead of the usual options without taking this penalty.

**[Greater Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=65)** <actions string="Single Action" />  3d8+5 bludgeoning, DC 29

**Spiritual Venom**   A vicharamuni can choose to negate any damage that its venom does to a creature. In addition, the naga can cast any of its divine spells on a creature that is affected by its venom, regardless of range or line of effect.

**Vicharamuni Venom**  ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [Spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=149)) **Saving Throw** DC 29 Will; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 3d6 spirit (1 round); **Stage 2** 3d6 spirit and [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68) (1 round)

</column>
